sentences.text: Lung cancer , also known as lung carcinoma , is a malignant lung tumor characterized by uncontrolled cell growth in tissues of the lung .	lung tumor	lung tumor	cell growth	cell growth	tissues	tissue (biology)	lung	lung	cancer	cancer
This growth can spread beyond the lung by the process of metastasis into nearby tissue or other parts of the body .	lung	lung	metastasis	metastasis
Most cancers that start in the lung , known as primary lung cancers , are carcinomas .	lung	lung	carcinomas	carcinomas

The two main types are small-cell lung carcinoma -LRB- SCLC -RRB- and non-small-cell lung carcinoma -LRB- NSCLC -RRB- .	non-small-cell lung carcinoma	non-small-cell lung carcinoma	lung	lung	small-cell lung carcinoma	small-cell lung carcinoma
The most common symptoms are coughing -LRB- including coughing up blood -RRB- , weight loss , shortness of breath , and chest pains .	coughing up blood	Hemoptysis
The vast majority -LRB- 85 % -RRB- of cases of lung cancer are due to long-term tobacco smoking .	lung	lung	cancer	cancer	tobacco smoking	tobacco smoking
About 10 -- 15 % of cases occur in people who have never smoked .

These cases are often caused by a combination of genetic factors and exposure to radon gas , asbestos , second-hand smoke , or other forms of air pollution .	genetic factors	genetics	radon	radon	asbestos	asbestos	air pollution	air pollution	second-hand smoke	passive smoking
Lung cancer may be seen on chest radiographs and computed tomography -LRB- CT -RRB- scans .	cancer	cancer	computed tomography	computed tomography
The diagnosis is confirmed by biopsy which is usually performed by bronchoscopy or CT-guidance .	diagnosis	medical diagnosis	biopsy	biopsy	bronchoscopy	bronchoscopy
Avoidance of risk factors , including smoking and air pollution , is the primary method of prevention .	air pollution	air pollution

Common treatments include surgery , chemotherapy , and radiotherapy .	chemotherapy	chemotherapy	radiotherapy	radiation therapy	surgery	surgery
NSCLC is sometimes treated with surgery , whereas SCLC usually responds better to chemotherapy and radiotherapy .	chemotherapy	chemotherapy	radiotherapy	radiation therapy	surgery	surgery
Worldwide in 2012 , lung cancer occurred in 1.8 million people and resulted in 1.6 million deaths .	lung	lung	cancer	cancer
This makes it the most common cause of cancer-related death in men and second most common in women after breast cancer .	cancer	cancer	breast cancer	breast cancer
